messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted API queue > threshold in us-west2 (service=hosted-api). p95 and p99 spike. autoremediation failed. See metrics: https://grafana.redwood/hosted-api
maria: Paging oncall...
oncall-sre: I'm oncall. seeing queue length 22,400 reqs, GPU pool util 99.7%, provisioner pending creations 148, autoscaler in backoff. p95=1.8s p99=12.3s, 504 rate ~3.2%
ryan-eng-runtime: looking. provisioner logs show `quotaExceeded` when calling cloud API to create GPU instances
maria: is this a cloud quota/region capacity issue or autoscaler bug?
oncall-sre: cloud returns 403 quotaExceeded. autoscaler respecting quota and backing off. there's also transient InsufficientCapacity errors for a subset of AZs
kevin-support: weaving in customer impact - some customers report timeouts and retries. Support ticket count up 14, 2 high-priority customers affected
ops-bot: runbook step 2: attempt soft-failover to fallback model
ops-bot: command: `/runbook hosted-api fallback-route --to redwood-small-8bit --pct 25`
maria: go for 25% fallback now
ryan-eng-runtime: routing 25% to redwood-small-8bit. expect latency drop but quality tradeoffs. watch p50/p95
oncall-sre: manual scale attempt blocked by quota. raising quota request with cloud console now; filing ticket `INC-9876` with cloud support
jamie-sre: can we throttle bursty API keys? Might reduce backlog quickly
maria: yes. implement per-key emergency throttle: `policy:set rate_limit emergency 10r/s for keys with >500 rps`
leah-eng: applied throttle policy. top offender keys now limited; queue dropped from 22.4k -> 14.8k in 6m
oncall-sre: good. p95 down to 1.1s p99 6.2s. 504s down to 1.1%
ryan-eng-runtime: we can also manually bring up a smaller GPU SKU in another region and route traffic there if cloud quota approves
maria: open a manual provision PR for `us-west2-fallback-pool` and ping infra
ops-bot: created fallback pool request `fp-321` in infra ticket tracker
kevin-support: update sent to customers A,B with mitigation and ETA for full recovery
oncall-sre: paging escalation to infra for quota - @infra please assist, cloud quota request in flight. contact cloud support and request emergency increase
infra: acknowledged, contacting cloud partner now (call in 3m)
maria: plan to keep fallback routing and throttles until quota increase confirmed. once we can scale, we'll gradually shift traffic back.
ryan-eng-runtime: follow-up action: postmortem owners: maria, ryan, jamie. runbook gaps: autoscaler backoff behavior when quotas hit; add metric and alert for `provisioner.quota_errors`
maria: agreed. also add post-incident customer impact summary and timeline
oncall-sre: handing off to night oncall @jamie-sre. last logs attached. continuing monitoring
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: queue stabilized. current queue 4,200. p95=210ms p99=1.2s. incident status: mitigated, monitoring.
maria: closing thread for now. will open postmortem doc and link it here.
kevin-support: thanks all :thumbsup:
